summary: The game crashes when opening the inventory while in spectator mode
description: The Bug: The game crashes when opening the inventory while in spectator mode. A crash report regarding this has been attached and can be found below. This issue also doesn t appear to happen all of the time. Stack Trace: [^crash-2024-08-15_16.59.43-client.txt] Description: Rendering screen java.lang.NullPointerException: Cannot invoke "faz.a(boolean)" because the return value of "ggr.t()" is null at ghd.h(SourceFile:578) at ghd.a(SourceFile:39) at com.google.common.collect.ImmutableList.forEach(ImmutableList.java:422) at ghe$a.b(SourceFile:1231) at ghd.a(SourceFile:39) at ghe.a(SourceFile:1016) at ggv$a.a(SourceFile:96) at ggv$a.a(SourceFile:85) at ggv$a.a(SourceFile:69) at ggv$a.b(SourceFile:75) at fjn.e(SourceFile:96) at fri.a(SourceFile:160) at fri.a(SourceFile:133) at fri.a(SourceFile:102) at fqi.b(SourceFile:176) at fpt.a(SourceFile:126) at fqi.a(SourceFile:113) at fra.a(SourceFile:33) at fri.a(SourceFile:84) at fpt.c(SourceFile:117) at ggl.a(SourceFile:892) at fib.c(SourceFile:1305) at fib.f(SourceFile:894) at net.minecraft.client.main.Main.main(SourceFile:256) Steps to Reproduce: - Open your inventory while in spectator mode. Observed Behavior: The game crashes. Expected Behavior: The game would not crash.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft.  
2. Enter any world and switch to spectator mode using the command `/gamemode spectator`.  
3. Open Options → Video Settings and set Graphics to **Fabulous**.  
4. Press the inventory key (default **E**) to open the inventory screen.  
5. Observe that the game crashes.
Observed Behavior: When the player is in spectator mode and attempts to open the inventory screen the client terminates abruptly, producing a crash report that shows a NullPointerException originating from a rendering routine where a method call on a null object is attempted; the stack trace lists calls through ghd, ghe, ggv and related classes before reaching the main entry point. The crash does not occur on every attempt, but it can be reproduced consistently on snapshot 24w33a, especially when the graphics preset is set to Fabulous, and it has also been observed when the player is in creative mode and clicks the chest icon. The error appears to be linked to the same code path as bugs MC‑191431 and MC‑275566, suggesting a shared underlying issue with the inventory rendering pipeline. In normal operation the inventory should open without terminating the game.
Expected Behavior: When a player in spectator mode presses the inventory key, the game should display the inventory screen (or the appropriate spectator UI) without terminating or throwing an error. The screen should render normally, allowing the player to view their hotbar and any accessible containers, and the player should remain in spectator mode with normal controls intact.
